plan.title: Cancel Configuration on Saved eRFX Draft

steps.note: Open the existing saved draft; because it is a draft, this should return to its create screen.
Open the RFQ Configuration for Event window requested by the case.
Assert that the configuration window opened.
Cancel the configuration without saving any changes.
Assert that the Configuration for Event window closed after cancellation.
